value.rationale: This is a motivated sharpness/boundary test of a recently established invisibility condition for state-dependent delay equations. It exhibits three distinct mathematical phenomena at one natural slope threshold: failure of nested trajectory agreement, nonconvergent substitution despite uniqueness of the implicit delay, and reversal of the actual feedback sign above threshold. This is a concrete structural counterexample family, not merely a numerical flip observation.
